changes.behavior: Construct every link in all state roots before validating any resolved reference. Keep temporary directories writable until links and nanosecond timestamps are complete, then apply captured directory modes deepest first and compare complete trees. Captured link text/reference, ownership, file bytes, modes and nanosecond times remain required.

Recognize only exact qa_core.Failure/support.Failure checkpoint codes from literal require calls in three fixed reviewed source files. Emit code and fixed-code category; category is not an observed last runtime phase. Before/after cleanup and complete bounded scan retain the recognized record without publishing traceback paths or free text.

Require opt-in at fetch, pipeline and restore. Validate the actual current active consumer against ordinary current API and its recorded job origin; separately validate exact historical completed run, successful producer and sole unexpired artifact. Verify full downloaded size/hash/gzip and all existing archive/payload/reference constraints. Compare complete context key sets; only run, attempt, head and fixture use fixed historical origin values, while every other value must equal actual current context. Keep both provenances in the receipt; never mutate manifest or real execution environment.

After complete restore, run mach environment and both actual restored-config and normal effective-config verification, then return restore-ready. Full build, package and native suites are not executed or qualified by this gate.
